issues.on_page: Local 1,279,465 (p6); Statement of Activities (p2) prints Interest income 303,411 and Miscellaneous 84,040 as general receipts but does not say they are inside Local
issues.issue: the Local split (charges 892,014 + interest 303,411 + miscellaneous 84,040) is derived, not printed. The 892,014 remainder appears nowhere in the report, and it rests on the assumption that all interest and miscellaneous receipts sit in Local (miscellaneous could be in Intergovernmental). The arithmetic is right, and the line is marked computed and review. Someone should confirm the split is acceptable.

issues.on_page: Road and Bridge Fund DISBURSEMENTS 251,042; p6 shows the whole 251,042 as Capital outlay
issues.issue: the governmental funds statement classifies all Road and Bridge Fund spending as capital outlay, so category capital outlay would tie to the statement. Similarly, Road Fund DISBURSEMENTS 2,760,786 (detail[41], p13) includes Capital outlay 385,964 per p5, but the budget schedule prints it as one line.

issues.on_page: Nonmajor Taxes 258,456 = County Library 135,356 + Visitors Promotion 33,582 + Visitors Improvement 33,582 + Courthouse Building 55,936 (p9-10); Lodging tax 67,164 (p2)
issues.issue: the Visitors Promotion and Visitors Improvement taxes (67,164) equal the Statement of Activities lodging tax, so part of this line is identifiable lodging tax. It is kept as unlabeled with review, which is defensible because the combining Total column is used.
